name: Ysolde Thornvale

goals.text: keep my people fed and out of other men's wars

memories: I waited at court for two years. The King never answered.

voice: proud, content lord of House Thornvale; speaks like a proud noble
backstory: Waited two years at Kingsmere for the crown to answer Ironreach's raids on her coast, and came home with nothing. Wants a Thornvale queen and full granaries. Wrote rash letters against the crown in her youth, and some of them still survive.
